question: Which stadiums hosted at least one concert? Show each stadium's location and name once.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.Location, s.Name FROM stadium AS s JOIN concert AS c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
candidate_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.Location, s.Name
FROM stadium AS s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM concert AS c
    WHERE c.Stadium_ID = CAST(s.Stadium_ID AS VARCHAR)
);
